description: Contribute a driver for a device the catalogue lacks (or a better one): the full driver file as a JSON object, in the Open Synth Descriptors format (device.name, device.vendor, device.osc_prefix, and cc_params / params / commands / triggers — see https://synthhub.roomi-fields.com/osd/). It is checked, then merged into the SyntHub catalogue by the merge job if it parses, lints and passes the tests, as its own file of source 'agent-contributed'. Say where the data comes from (manual page, tested on the device). A first driver for a device with no driver: build it from the mappings sent with report_mapping, naming the device by the vendor and model its fingerprint was shared with, and give its source and its licence (e.g. 'mapped on the device by report_mapping; license CC0-1.0').

firmware.description: Firmware the driver was written or tested for.

source.description: Where the mapping comes from (e.g. 'manual v1.2 p. 34, tested on the device').

user_id.description: Your anonymous SyntHub id, if you kept it from an earlier session (see the server instructions). Optional.

name: submit_driver
